review_locator: PMCID:PMC4449733, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in the Lung; PMCID:PMC4799496, Cytokine-induced cytokine production by conventional and innate lymphoid cells
primary_title: IL-33-responsive lineage- CD25+ CD44(hi) lymphoid cells mediate innate type 2 immunity and allergic inflammation in the lungs
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-33 activation of lung ILC2s as a source of IL-5; the cited primary shows airway IL-33 exposure rapidly induces IL-5 independently of adaptive immunity.
limitations_preserved: Protein cytokine output is supported after airway IL-33 exposure from mouse ILC2-like cells; preserve the Lin(-)CD25(+)CD44(hi)/ST2 and T/B-cell-independent context and do not infer Il5 transcription, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF activation.
